comment: The document says that divergence from the reference becomes visible and can be reasoned about. This depends on countries using comparable modelling conventions and recording the rationale for divergence, which are not yet required here.

anchor.note: p.53 l.Lines 213-216 read as the printed page; section 3.3 agrees

public.text: The document says that divergence from the reference becomes visible and can be reasoned about. This depends on countries using comparable modelling conventions and recording the rationale for divergence, which are not yet required here.
public.suggestedRevision: Require national adaptations to maintain explicit mappings to reference elements and to document whether each element is adopted, adapted, replaced, combined, deferred, or excluded, including the rationale and effect on conformance.
